text: Carpentry defines the practice of building or fixing items like houses, cabinets, and furniture with wood. Sawing acts as a central task; it uses a sharp blade to slice timber into exact sections. This cutting usually starts the job, generating the required dimensions and forms for the finished object. Next, sanding takes place to grind down rough surfaces on the pieces. This step makes sure the item works well and looks good. Sanding also gets rid of flaws in the grain, improving longevity and quality. Mixing these two actions allows carpenters to realize their plans, producing solid structures meant for many uses.
